title: Hold everything Claude wrote out of every training run and export until rights review
request: The owner asked to check the decision sets for Claude's outputs, and answered 'Everything Claude wrote' on scope: keep and prepare everything, and hold Claude's labels, answers, thinking, and written people or requests out of every training run and training export until rights_reviewed is true.
spec: A single store module (dclab_rnd/store/writers.py) classifies every training schema (decision, routing, judged, episode, preference, retrieval, chat, trajectory, and written sets) and exposes writer_of(), held(), held_writer(), reading_held(), set_writer(), HeldForRights, and an audit CLI. export_chat, tutor, routing export, GLiNER2 export, intent_classifier, workflow_models, understand_students, and decision_export query writers before reading or writing training data; code-made data stays unheld.
plan: G1: create dclab_rnd/store/writers.py with writer_of, held, held_writer, reading_held, set_writer, HeldForRights, and audit.
G3: measure baseline audit counts and routing, GLiNER2, and chat exports before guards.
G4: commit writers.py and test_store_writers.py with baseline audit totals.
G5: guard export_chat.py with who_wrote.writer_of for test-workspace conversations and test it.
G6: guard tutor.py so held teacher labels stay out of train and dev fitting.
G7: guard routing.py export and chat_row so held rows and held model readings/thinking stay out.
G8: guard lake/answers.py export_gliner2 across routing, journeys, and workflow sources.
G9: commit G5 to G8 export guards and their tests.

G10: guard intent_classifier.py, workflow_models.py, understand_students.py (raising HeldForRights before writing), and decision_export.py (skipping held workflow_v1 rows), add tests/test_trainers_hold_written_people.py, and apply the one allowed change to failing existing trainer tests.
G11: measure audit and routing, GLiNER2, and chat exports after guards, verify exams clean and catalog fresh.
G12: update CLAUDE.md, write this record, run make sft-dev, run the 15-file final test suite, commit, push main and dev, and report.

decisions.decision: One module decides who wrote a row, and every trainer and export asks it
decisions.why: seven places each had their own rule or none

decisions.decision: A written set is a provider's unless its records say otherwise
decisions.why: every hand-made journey and request file was committed with Claude as co-author

decisions.decision: A trainer refuses before writing anything
decisions.why: a fitted model is never overwritten by a run with nothing to learn from
an invented table or a measured label is the code's output

change: Added dclab_rnd/store/writers.py and tests/test_store_writers.py (commit c0021683); guarded store/export_chat.py, store/tutor.py, store/sets/routing.py, and lake/answers.py with tests (commit d13b5f8c); guarded intent_classifier.py, workflow_models.py, understand_students.py, and decision_export.py, added tests/test_trainers_hold_written_people.py, updated 8 existing trainer tests and 2 routing tests with the may_train=True patch, updated CLAUDE.md, and recorded this package.

findings.defect: store/tutor.py teach fell back to Claude's teacher labels (decision_labeler) when a point had fewer than 20 confirmed labels.
findings.scenario: On points in m1_students, m2_workflow_decisions, and m3_ml_decisions with teacher labels (1,121, 96, and 532 held rows across those sets), tutor.teach trained students on teacher labels before rights review.
findings.cause: tutor._rows and tutor.teach filtered only by label presence and confirmed source count without checking who_wrote.held(ex).
findings.fix: Annotated rows in tutor._rows with 'held': who_wrote.held(ex), excluded held rows from train and dev sets in tutor.teach, and counted held rows in report['held_for_rights'].

findings.defect: store/sets/routing.py export emitted Claude silver labels, written requests, test people's words, Claude's thinking in chat reasoning, and model/model_thinking columns in table.csv.
findings.scenario: Exporting m7_routing wrote 9,634 rows across 33 chat files including silver and written folders and populated model_thinking from provider readings.
findings.cause: routing.chat_row and routing.export checked only whether words existed and whether the labeller gave a reading, without calling writers.writer_of or writers.reading_held.
findings.fix: Skipped held rows in routing.export via who_wrote.writer_of(ex) (counted in skipped), stripped held model readings in export and chat_row via who_wrote.reading_held, and documented the hold in MANIFEST rule.

findings.defect: lake/answers.py export_gliner2 exported routing silver/written rows, written journeys, and journey-played workflow rows.
findings.scenario: Running answers.export_gliner2 emitted 125 files across committee, lake, selfplay, routing, journeys (3 files), and workflow (8 files).
findings.cause: _routing, _journeys, _workflow, and export_gliner2 attached no writer attribution and checked no hold switch.
findings.fix: Attached 'writer' via who_wrote.writer_of or who_wrote.set_writer in _routing, _journeys, and _workflow, and skipped held rows in export_gliner2 under counts['held_for_rights'].

findings.defect: intent_classifier.train trained on intent_requests_v1.json (871 requests written by Claude Sonnet 5.5).
findings.scenario: Calling intent_classifier.train fit and overwrote model artifacts using Claude-authored requests while rights_reviewed was false.
findings.cause: intent_classifier.train performed no writer check on the request file.
findings.fix: Added who_wrote.held_writer(who_wrote.set_writer(Path(requests).stem)) check right after load_rows(requests) in intent_classifier.train to raise HeldForRights before fitting or writing.

findings.defect: understand_students.train fit models on journeys written by Claude (homework_v1 Claude Sonnet; homework_v2 and homework_v3 model-authored).
findings.scenario: Calling understand_students.train created directories and trained state and text students from written journey sets while rights_reviewed was false.
findings.cause: understand_students.train did not inspect sources against who_wrote.set_writer and who_wrote.held_writer.
findings.fix: Filtered held journey sources in understand_students.train and raised HeldForRights before out.mkdir when all labelled rows come from held sets.

findings.defect: workflow_models.train fit models on workflow decisions played from written journey sets created in Claude Code sessions.
findings.scenario: Calling workflow_models.train wrote model artifacts from written journey plays without checking the provider rights hold.
findings.cause: workflow_models.train never checked who wrote the source journey sets.
findings.fix: Computed held sources via who_wrote.set_writer and held_writer before out = Path(out), raised HeldForRights when all labelled rows are held, and filtered held sources in the training loop.

findings.defect: decision_export.build exported workflow_v1 decision rows played from written journeys.
findings.scenario: Reading workflow_v1/decisions/rows.jsonl included rows played from dev and journey sets written by Claude without holding or counting them.
findings.cause: decision_export.rows read every rows.jsonl line uniformly and never checked workflow_v1 row sources against writers.
findings.fix: Updated decision_export.rows and decision_export.build to hold workflow_v1 rows whose set_writer is held and record their count in manifest['held_for_rights'].

findings.defect: store/export_chat.py exported chat rows from live_tests__ test workspaces when check named rules instead of a provider model.
findings.scenario: understand_problem v2 exported conversations from test workspaces whose simulated user turns were written for the test.
findings.cause: export_chat.export checked only provider_of(row) and never asked writers.writer_of(row) for test-workspace provenance.
findings.fix: Updated export_chat.export to fall back via who = who or who_wrote.writer_of(row), holding test-workspace conversations under held_for_rights['claude'] (296 additional rows held in understand_problem v2).

measurements.next: leave all guards active until the owner records rights_reviewed: true
limits: counts cover train and dev rows only; sealed sets are never read by audit or export

outcome: All seven remaining training paths and test-workspace chat exports now respect provider_outputs.may_train() through dclab_rnd/store/writers.py while leaving existing stored data and fitted models intact.
lessons: Evaluating every dataset schema inside one shared writers module avoids drift between chat exports, decision trainers, and GLiNER2 formatters.
Distinguishing provenance authored by Claude Code or written-request generators from code-synthesized tables ensures only provider-written text and labels are held.
risks: The intent classifier, the understanding students, and the workflow models cannot be retrained until the owner records the rights review.
The lake keeps its own rule (Claude outputs are evaluation only) and was not changed.
A test workspace's words are held even when a test replayed a real person's words.
